To move fast on your feet.
Bahasa Indonesia: berlari
Example: I run to school.
cards.say: run. To move fast on your feet. I run to school.

cards.back:
To move on your feet, not fast.
Bahasa Indonesia: berjalan
Example: We walk to the shop.
cards.say: walk. To move on your feet, not fast. We walk to the shop.

Example: Close your book.
